text:
deploy-bot: Started rollout v2 -> route /v2/generate, canary 10%, commit 3b7f2c1. Watchers: @sasha @chris @maya

sasha: seeing a spike in 422s from mobile clients right after the canary went live. sample logs attached.

chris: hmm, mobile SDK deserializing response body expecting `choices: [string]` but v2 switched to `choices: [{structured: {...}}]`. likely parse errors on older SDKs.

maya: metrics: error budget dip — p50 latency stable, p95 up 20ms, 422/400s increased from 0.3% -> 4.1% in last 3m, affected traffic looks concentrated to user_agent ~ MobileSDK/* and some older android agents.

ops-oncall: recommendation: pause canary and apply client-level pin to send matching MobileSDK user agents to /v1/generate. Rolling full rollback will impact web and server SDKs that expect v2.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% (actioned). Need a decision: rollback entire route to v1 OR pin by client at gateway. @julie please advise on customer comms if we pin. :warning:

julie: I'll draft a short notice for affected customers. Pin sounds less disruptive for customers that already adopted v2. We'll need to notify top 10 accounts and support channels.

eli: I can add a gateway pin quickly. Example command to apply (admin only):

```
curl -X POST https://gateway.internal/admin/pins \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v2/generate","match":"user_agent =~ \"MobileSDK/.*\"","target":"/v1/generate","reason":"v2 response schema breaking older mobile SDKs"}'
```

chris: that looks right. Also create an allowlist for any mobile apps on staging that already handle v2; we can add by client-id later.

kevin: support queue is already filling with "JSON parse error" stacktraces. If we pin now we can reduce impact quickly. Timeline?

ops-oncall: if we apply pin now, rollback not required. We should still ensure we have a patch release + SDK fix.

sasha: creating follow-up card: FIX-489 SDK compatibility adapter + integration test. Will open PR against v2 adapter now. Reference PR: #789 (WIP).

deploy-bot: Pin request received, applying...

deploy-bot: Pin applied successfully for route /v2/generate where user_agent =~ MobileSDK/.* -> routed to /v1/generate. (change-id: pin-2026-03-15-01)

maya: after pin, 422s dropped back to baseline within 90s. p95 latency returning to normal. Good quick win. :thumbsup:

chris: plan going forward: 1) keep pin until SDK + server adapter fix rolls out and clients update, 2) add automated integration tests that exercise older client schemas in CI, 3) update release notes to call out breaking change and migration path.

julie: I'll push a customer note to staging now and ping support and account teams.

kevin: tagging top accounts in support thread. we'll escalate any paying customers that need immediate SDK backport.

ops-oncall: monitoring dashboard updated, alert threshold adjusted to catch regressions during pin removal.

sasha: postmortem card created: PM-2026-v2-schema-break. Assigning owners: sasha (server fix), chris (integration tests), julie (comms), eli (gateway pin automation), kevin (support follow-up).

chris: final ask — please hold any further v2 traffic increases until adapter PR lands and we run canary specifically against mobile user_agents on staging.

deploy-bot: Noted. Canary remains at 10% for other clients; mobile pinned to v1.

sasha: errors baseline confirmed at 1958926400, no further elevated errors. Closing thread once postmortem is posted.

kevin: thanks all — quick action prevented larger outage.
